title: GradingVerdictPutRequest
description: Save or overwrite the CALLER'S verdict on a task (PUT /v1/grading/tasks/{task_id}/verdict). The reader is the authenticated subject — there is no field to name another reader, so a row can only ever be written by its owner. Whole-row replace: an omitted `span_judgements`/`extra_answers`/`notes` clears it, it does not keep the previous value.

span_judgements.description: Per-span judgements; every (`set`, `span`) MUST exist on the task (422). Default empty.

extra_answers.description: Answers to the task's extra questions; every `id` MUST exist on the task (422). Default empty.
